command: After the 16-GiB admission guard passes, use scripts/run_memory_capped.sh with -j1 and a 9G/10G user-cgroup limit to rebuild the transcript that includes official packet drains and big-endian U16 input/output lane packing. Preserve the first true divergence at output block 0 word 0: expected 0x00710070006d0070, observed 0x00700070006e0070.
success_condition: The actual Garnet top accepts the post-PCFG input transcript, finishes the official stream sequence, and every output byte matches the upstream Gaussian golden without a timeout, protocol error, or dropped packet.
failure_policy: Preserve the verified PCFG transcript. Locate the first divergent output block, control interrupt, or proc-packet transaction; do not bypass Garnet with nested Interconnect ports or alter official packet/AXI values. Do not start a heavy task below 16 GiB available memory; keep it at -j1 inside the user memory cgroup.
